Gujarat High Court and Ahmedabad Courts Receive Bomb Threat Email

The Registrar of the Gujarat High Court received a bomb threat email on Saturday morning, which was then forwarded to the Ahmedabad City Police. Following the email, all courts in Ahmedabad were placed on high alert, with security teams conducting searches. The threat stated that all courts in Ahmedabad would be bombed. Security has been heightened in Ahmedabad and Surat.
